ThingDef.label: kwazaari pistol
ThingDef.description: A simple semi-automatic pistol mass-produced from a Free-to-Use template which had its patent run out. Vastly superior to conventional firearms in many aspects aside from range and accuracy.

ThingDef.label: kwazaari chain shotgun
ThingDef.description: A drum-fed fully automatic shotgun which sprays destructive amounts of mildly-heated quasar alloy. Originally the weapon came strictly in semi-automatic but was quickly remachined into full automatic after illegally modified versions were confiscated following a ten second police firefight with tax evaders.

ThingDef.label: kwazaari assault rifle
ThingDef.description: A mass-produced rifle that is resistant to most forms of stress and abuse, while also being cheap to repair. While highly adjustable and customizable many of the parts do not come with the weapon itself, sold as separate overpriced pieces by haggling vendors, thankfully it does come with a variety of holographic flip-up sights and a compensator.

ThingDef.label: kwazaari sniper rifle
ThingDef.description: Little more than a tube of Quasar metal, a bolt, and a stock, The Kwazaari sniper rifle is a by-product of a quite literal cutthroat business environment, where a bad deal can be the difference between a promotion and unmarked shallow grave.

ThingDef.label: kwazaari lmg
ThingDef.description:
A box of dangerously strong bullets belt-fed into a hulking behemoth of a weapon, the Kwazaari LMG is capable of suppressing an entire boardroom for the duration of three conference calls or your money back* 



*No Refunds, All Sales Final

ThingDef.label: quasar gauss pistol
ThingDef.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern quasar-era warfare. Refined Solarite integration enables electromagnetic acceleration of Sunsteel rounds to devastating effect. The Solar Republics' counter-mechanoid specialists relied on this compact pistol to supplement their arsenal, its superior kickback management allowing sustained fire despite the weapon's formidable power output.

ThingDef.label: quasar gauss shotgun
ThingDef.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern quasar-era warfare. A compact electromagnetic shotgun engineered by the Solar Republics for intense close-quarters counter-mechanoid engagements. Solarite reinforcement allows the weapon's frame to withstand the immense recoil forces from its unique fragmented projectile design, making it devastating in the hands of well-trained specialists.

ThingDef.label: quasar gauss rifle
ThingDef.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern quasar-era warfare. A versatile electromagnetic rifle utilizing Solar Republics' breakthrough in Solarite-enhanced weapon design. Built specifically for counter-mechanoid operations, the rifle's refined recoil distribution allows even moderately-trained soldiers to maintain accurate sustained fire when facing hostile synthetic threats.

ThingDef.label: quasar gauss dmr
ThingDef.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern quasar-era warfare. A designated marksman rifle developed by the Solar Republics for counter-mechanoid specialists. Solarite integration provides exceptional accuracy and stopping power against synthetic targets, while the weapon's recoil compensation system allows sustained rapid fire without degrading accuracy.

ThingDef.label: quasar gauss bullpup
ThingDef.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern quasar-era warfare. A compact yet powerful electromagnetic rifle built for close-quarters counter-mechanoid operations. The Solarite-enhanced frame absorbs the intense recoil forces generated by the gauss accelerator, enabling effective suppressive fire in confined spaces where Solar Republic anti-synthetics teams operate.

ThingDef.label: quasar gauss sniper rifle
ThingDef.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern quasar-era warfare. The pinnacle of Solar Republic counter-mechanoid firepower. This precision electromagnetic rifle features Solarite reinforcement throughout its frame to withstand the immense stresses of electromagnetic acceleration. Deployed by elite anti-synthetic specialists, it delivers devastating firepower at extreme range with minimal recoil.

ThingDef.label: quasar gauss cannon
ThingDef.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern quasar-era warfare. A rapid-fire electromagnetic cannon developed by the Solar Republics as the ultimate counter-mechanoid suppressive weapon. Solarite reinforcement allows sustained burst fire without structural degradation, and the weapon's recoil management system enables accurate fire despite its devastating power.

ThingDef.label: quasar beam pistol
ThingDef.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern quasar-era warfare. A compact Solar Republic beam sidearm engineered for shipboard security operations. Its sealed electromagnetic emitter generates zero atmospheric discharge, making it ideal for operations within vacuum-sealed spacecraft. Developed during early Solar Republic counter-mechanoid campaigns, it delivers reliable close-range performance without risk of hull breach.

ThingDef.label: quasar beam rifle
ThingDef.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern quasar-era warfare. A standard-issue Solar Republic beam rifle, designed from the ground up for space assault operations. The laser emitter produces no chemical propellant byproducts, making this weapon perfectly safe aboard vacuum-sealed spacecraft and space stations. Widely deployed by Solar Republic boarding parties against mechanoid threats in orbital combat.

ThingDef.label: quasar beam scatter
ThingDef.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern quasar-era warfare. A close-quarters Solar Republic beam scatter weapon designed for corridor fighting aboard spacecraft and orbital facilities. Its modified prism scatters the beam into multiple overlapping pulses, providing devastating close-range coverage without risk to spacecraft hull integrity. Engineered specifically for anti-mechanoid suppression in confined vacuum environments.

ThingDef.label: quasar beam dmr
ThingDef.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern quasar-era warfare. A precision Solar Republic beam designated marksman rifle, used by specialist units conducting anti-mechanoid operations in the void of space. Its tight beam focus allows for accurate semi-automatic fire without producing any recoil or atmospheric discharge, making it exceptionally effective aboard space installations where conventional firearms would pose serious risks.

ThingDef.label: quasar beam bullpup
ThingDef.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern quasar-era warfare. A compact Solar Republic close-quarters beam weapon designed for rapid anti-mechanoid clearance in confined spacecraft compartments. The bullpup configuration minimizes length without sacrificing beam path, allowing effective suppressive fire in tight corridors and airlocks. Engineered for space combat, its sealed emitter produces no atmospheric discharge, preventing hull damage during interior operations.

ThingDef.label: quasar beam lmg
ThingDef.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern quasar-era warfare. A heavy-duty Solar Republic beam repeater designed as a sustained fire platform for anti-mechanoid operations in space. Its high-capacity focusing arrays deliver continuous bursts of coherent energy without fouling or recoil, ideal for prolonged engagements within spacecraft corridors. The complete absence of combustion products makes it safe to operate in fully vacuum-sealed environments.

ThingDef.label: quasar beam sniper rifle
ThingDef.description: Developed from earlier solarite prototype programs, this kwazaari production model refines and weaponizes the original concept for modern quasar-era warfare. The most powerful precision beam weapon produced by the Solar Republics for vacuum operations. Its advanced optical focusing array delivers devastating energy at extreme ranges, originally developed to eliminate mechanoid threats before they could breach spacecraft hulls. The weapon's complete absence of chemical propulsion makes it uniquely suited to sealed space environments.
